sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors for company reporting: Methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Homeworking heating factors remain constant since the 2022 conversion-factor publication apart from the GWP-basis update.
Homeworking heating factors were updated from AR4 to AR5 GWP values.
The heating method uses annual-average home-heating energy estimates.
The method uses Ofgem typical domestic consumption data and UK heat-use estimates.
Natural-gas conversion factors come from the UK GHG Conversion Factors fuel-model outputs.
The model assumes UK home heating is powered by natural gas for this calculation.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve model assumption; do not present as universal fact.

facts.source_fact: The model assumes a six-month heating season from October to March.
The model assumes heating is used ten hours per day during the heating season.
Only two-thirds of employees moving to homeworking are assumed to cause incremental heating energy because one-third are assumed to have someone already at home.
These are modelling assumptions for company reporting and must not be presented as measured household or parcel heating use.
